remarks: Live your best life at Wilton Crest in this private, end-unit, one-bedroom condo that has just been completely renovated-everything is brand new! This bright and airy home features an open kitchen thoughtfully designed with sleek stainless steel appliances and pristine white cabinets and quartz countertops. The wood composite flooring flows beautifully throughout, while the marble bathroom, complete with radiant heat, keeps the floors cozy all winter long. Storage is plentiful, including a spacious walk-in closet and a basement storage unit. Step outside through the sliding doors to your private balcony, where you'll enjoy views of the lush and expertly maintained landscaping. Residents of this small community have access to a variety of amenities, including a swimming pool, tennis courts, and all enclosed with private grounds. Despite the tranquil setting, you're just minutes from Wilton Town Center, which offers a vibrant mix of shopping, dining, and convenient access to the train station for commuters. Additional perks in-building laundry facilities, a private garage, and extra allocated parking spaces. This unit is ready for immediate occupancy , the tenant must have good credit and applications are to be completed through rent spree.
